LanguageData.JJK_CopySampleInvalid: Requires a downed hostile human or non-allied corpse with an innate technique and a remaining arm or hand. The caster must be within eight tiles and Rika within five.
LanguageData.JJK_CopyFull: Rika already holds three imprints. Forget one before consuming another sample.
LanguageData.JJK_CopyConsumeHelp: Choose a technique to copy. This consumes an actual arm or hand from the target. Three casts per sample; a living donor regrowing that part invalidates it. Copy and techniques you already possess are excluded.
LanguageData.JJK_CopyHelp: Rika stores up to three imprints. Select one while manifested to borrow its grade-eligible abilities. Three casts per imprint; domains cannot be borrowed. Forgetting an imprint does not restore its sample.
LanguageData.JJK_EndExpansionDefenseDesc: End Folded Sky, Inverse, Gravity Field and the support ritual. Does not refund spent energy.
